comments.author: @sandwichgod692
comments.text: I noticed these promos started becoming less and less subtle with each passing one. They started out advertising the show straight as this wholesome and innocent show about a sweet young boy learning life lessons. At guess they were doing such a good job fooling people into believing it was that they thought no one would watch. So they started showing clips from the show in their promos that are in direct contrast to how the announcer is describing it. Honestly, I like the first approach much better. Just the thought of manipulating people into believing that this wholesome family show was actually airing on Adult Swim only to tune in to discover that it’s anything but is hysterical to me.
